semantics.function: For each i from 0 through 7, out[i] = in[7-i].
semantics.timing: Pure combinational continuous mapping; no cycle latency or input capture.
semantics.initialization: No state or initialization required; output follows current input.
semantics.protocol: No handshake; all input bit patterns are legal.

numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, extension, truncation, rounding, saturation, or overflow.
numeric.ordering: Input bit 0 maps to output bit 7 and input bit 7 maps to output bit 0.
numeric.four_state: Bit permutation propagates each source bit including X or Z.

verification.method: Independent self-checking development testbench with arithmetic bit reversal oracle.
verification.binary_coverage: Exhaustively drive all 256 8-bit binary inputs and compare after combinational settling.
verification.four_state_coverage: Directed X and Z single-bit inputs checked at the reversed position.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp.
verification.bounds: Finite 30-second compile and simulation timeouts, plus testbench watchdog.
verification.success: No mismatches and explicit PASS marker.
